column1: # Declared hand-curated AI-developer orgs — MINIMAL, load-bearing rows only:
# each line is an org that (a) is a genuine AI developer, (b) has study-window
# AI evidence, and (c) would NOT be admitted by any other rule (not on Epoch/
# TechCrunch lists, topic-sparse repos). Trimmed 2026-07-10 from 33 to 14 by
# counterfactual test (remove list -> rerun engine -> keep only rows whose
# removal changes the population OR an org's full/repo-scoped status). Orgs that later gain evidence (e.g.
# thinking-machines-lab) are one line to re-add.
